hero.title: Double Your Listings, Half the Effort
hero.subtitle: The intelligent extension for Georgian real estate agents managing SS.ge and MyHome.ge listings simultaneously
hero.description: Streamline your workflow across multiple property platforms with our smart extension designed specifically for Georgian real estate professionals.

features.title: Core Capabilities
features.description: Powerful features designed for Georgian real estate professionals

oneClickExtraction.title: One-Click Data Extraction & Injection
oneClickExtraction.description: Seamlessly extract property data from SS.ge and inject it directly into MyHome.ge with a single click. No manual copying required.

dualPlatformFilling.title: Concurrent Dual-Platform Form Filling
dualPlatformFilling.description: Fill forms on both SS.ge and MyHome.ge simultaneously. Save time by updating both platforms at once.

customizableTemplates.title: Customizable Listing Templates
customizableTemplates.description: Create and customize templates for different deal types: sales, rentals, daily rentals, and mortgage listings. Reuse templates to speed up listings.

autoPriceAdjustment.title: Automatic Price Adjustments
autoPriceAdjustment.description: Adjust prices across both platforms with calculated rounding and area adjustments. Keep pricing consistent and competitive.

draftAlertProtection.title: Draft-Alert Protection
draftAlertProtection.description: Prevent accidental data loss with draft-alert notifications. Your work is automatically saved and protected across sessions.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.description: A simple three-step workflow to manage your listings across both platforms seamlessly

steps.title: Visit SS.ge
steps.description: Browse and open any property listing on SS.ge that you want to publish on MyHome.ge

steps.title: Extract Data
steps.description: Click the extension icon and select 'Extract' to automatically capture all property details and images

steps.title: Auto-Fill MyHome.ge
steps.description: Navigate to MyHome.ge and click 'Auto-fill' to populate the listing form with the extracted data in seconds

steps.title: Publish & Monitor
steps.description: Review the details, make any final adjustments, and publish to both platforms simultaneously with one click

simulator.title: Interactive Workflow Simulator
simulator.description: Watch how data flows seamlessly from SS.ge to MyHome.ge
